decisions.notes: Full IEEE Version of Record checked; PDF SHA-256 7ee9edfd4974a9577bcc5769679f44df1dfa45932ae43f56b1997d8c89a92922. MPP contains 701 valid video samples with audio, not 701 identified participants. Target is average FLACC rated by 1-4 medical doctors/sample. Five-fold CV is reported; fold unit and participant-disjoint assignment are not. No external validation or uncertainty calibration reported. Data are available from corresponding author on request.
decisions.rationale: Apply only the confirmed legacy modality field and its field resolution. The FLACC observer-rated construct is known; the controlled vocabulary currently lacks a dedicated observer-rated composite category, so the card retains the explicit vocabulary-gap sentinel.
